messages.subject: Project Ironvale - SPA mark-up (Sellers)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up of the SPA attached. The principal points from the Sellers' side: warranty de minimis up to £50k, aggregate threshold up to £500k, warranty notice period down to 18 months, and the restrictive covenant reduced to 2 years (3 is unreasonable given Geoffrey's age and the sector). Most other changes are tidy-ups.

Rachel

messages.subject: FW: Project Ironvale - SPA mark-up (Sellers)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Elena,

Hargrove's mark-up in. The thresholds and notice period we can largely live with given we have W&I, but I'd push back to meet in the middle (de minimis £40k, basket £400k, 21 months). The 2-year covenant is fine. Let's discuss before I turn it.

James
